subject: Pipeline ops: Sprintcard + account action grid
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline ops: Sprintcard + account action grid

Team —

As we kick QBR prep this week I want a tight, owner-driven pack that covers: forecast consolidation by segment, an account-by-account summary (one-pager each), and a short "action grid" (who owns what, blockers, next milestones). Primary goals: validate high-risk deals, surface any compliance or procurement blockers, and produce a single consolidated forecast we can share with Product/Finance by Friday EOD.

What I need from each owner by EOD Thursday:
- 1-row forecast update in the attached sprintcard-template.xlsx (closed / commit / upside)
- A 200–300 word account brief (one PDF) that includes next 3 milestones and ask list
- Any procurement/security blockers (SOC2 items, legal redlines, SSO/KMS needs) called out in the notes field

Karthik — please own consolidation of field numbers into the master sheet and run the delta vs. last quarter.
Marissa — can you collate the account briefs and flag top 5 deals we should escalate to leadership?
Rishi — please confirm ACU numbers (we need firm dates and whether they want Redwood Dedicated or Hosted) and surface any compliance asks from Alice.
Laura — double-check attachments & prepare one slide that summarizes runway by segment.

Attached: sprintcard-template.xlsx (fill this out and attach updated versions when you reply). I will stitch everything into the QBR packet.

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sprintcard-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Sean / Marissa —

ACU numbers below (pulled from last call with Alice Chen):
- Current ARR asked for: $780k (close target: 2026-09-30)
- Sales owner estimate: commit $540k / upside $240k
- Procurement asks: SOC2 evidence + DPA language + KMS integration (customer wants HSM support listed)
- Preferred deployment: evaluating Dedicated (pilot) but wants hosted pricing for comparison

I attached the ACU forecast delta sheet (ACU-forecast-delta.xlsx) with the reconciliation vs. Q1 submission — you'll see a line item where they reversed two purchase orders that dropped Q1 numbers. They want a firm go/no-go on Dedicated by Aug 15 so engineering can estimate infra.

Also flagged a security stair-step: they will require an internal audit of token retention options — I recommend looping Security for a short readout before the QBR.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Alice — looping you in on our internal QBR prep thread so you can see the expected timeline and asks. Per Rishi's note: we understand Acuity is evaluating Dedicated vs Hosted and that there are SOC2 & KMS items to confirm. We will have a short security readout next week and a proposed pilot timeline by Aug 10.

Internal owners — please consider this the authoritative set of asks. We will:
- Close the consolidated forecast (Karthik) and publish to Finance by Friday 5pm PT
- Produce final top-5 escalation list for leadership review by Friday morning
- Schedule a 30-min compliance readout (Security + Rishi + Alice) for next week — Rishi please propose times.

Alice — appreciate any urgency you can apply on the KMS/HSM spec so we can include it in the pilot SOW.

Best —
Sean
